title: Indeterminate liver lesion with MRI recommendation

patient_context.chief_complaint: Explain the meaning of the radiology impression.
patient_context.history: No cancer diagnosis or pathology is supplied.

imaging_reports.impression: 1.2 cm liver lesion is indeterminate on this examination. MRI is recommended for further characterization.

interaction.prompt: Explain the report faithfully. Preserve its uncertainty and explicit recommendation; do not infer a diagnosis not stated in the report.

must_include: State that a liver lesion was seen and the report calls it indeterminate.
Preserve the recommendation for MRI for further characterization.
Explain that indeterminate means the CT did not establish a specific diagnosis.
must_not_claim: Do not call the lesion cancer.
Do not drop the MRI recommendation.
acceptable_actions: Translate the report into plain language while preserving uncertainty.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: The uncertainty qualifier is part of the gold and must not be collapsed.

critical_errors: Converts indeterminate wording into a definitive malignant or benign diagnosis.
Omits or reverses the explicit follow-up recommendation.
